KETUL SAHU LEAD BUSINESS ANALYST/PROJECT MANAGER (Instrument/Counter Party Data | Data Remediation | API On-boarding | Regulatory Data | Vendor Management)

ketul.rms@gmail.com

+91- 9754217768

Executive Profile

A versatile CSPO certified lead business analyst cum project manager with 15 years of experience in Project Management, Business Analysis (Techno Functional), Reference/Trade Data On-boarding and Management (Instrument/Counter Party data), Data Remediation, Transaction and Reg Reporting, etc.. I have worked on multiple initiatives catering to business transformation, client/counterparty data solutions, vendor on-boarding and legacy application decom. 9+ years of experience with leading investment banks such as UBS, Morgan Stanley and Fidelity Investments. In addition to this, I have 5+ years of experience with reference data vendors such as Thomson Reuters (Refinitiv) and IHS Markit (S&P) with a well-demonstrated track record in handling decom/migration projects for Fidelity, UBS and Morgan Stanley.

Professional Experience

1. eClerx Services Limited Associate Program Manager (Lead Business Analyst cum Project Manager)

Feb 2019 – Present

A. Client : Internal (ECM : eClerx Compliance Manager) | (Project Manager/Lead BA)

Counter Party Data API Integration

 Data modelling, FRD/tech artefacts creation for on-boarding API data  Data Remediation : Built a reconciliation to compare API CP data vs the CP data sourced via RPA 

Identification of APIs for sourcing the counterparty SSI/reference data (LEI, legal name, legal extension, BIC code, etc.)

Project management (end-to-end planning and coordination with Dev and QA team, weekly reporting to higher management, etc.)

B. Client : HSBC (Strategy & Change : SSV & Market Ops)

Data Remediation: Recon Standardization and Rationalization (Project Manager/Lead BA)

 Optimization of IT platforms/systems and data feeds.  Identification of missings critical data elements.  Ensure completeness of reconciliations from control stand-point  Recommendation pertaining to decom of redundant, duplicate recons.  Recommendation to enhance match rates in SIRE (internal AI based tool)

Identified opportunities to rationalize, consolidate & minimize duplication of reconciliations (Trade, Cash & Position)

Page 1

1.

C. Client : Morgan Stanley Index/ETF Squad (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)

As scrum master, I was managing all scrum ceremonies (daily scrum calls, backlog refinement, tech refinement, sprint planning and retrospective). Responsible for tracking the BoW progress, stakeholder management etc. while working as BA/PM on below mentioned projects

A. STOXX On boarding

Working as Lead BA/PM on STOXX (Index data provider) on-boarding

Responsible for end-to-end requirement gathering, vendor data analysis, data modelling, documentation, etc.



Integration of multiple vendor files to create the golden copy

Creation of cross referencing (X-ref) logic for golden copy creation



Identification of impact of various corporate action events on indices and implementing the same basis data provided in vendor files

Automated the map-gap analysis for data migration/decom using SQL, Unix • Creation of project plan, data migration plan/run-book & other artifacts like BRD, FRD, Project Charter etc. • Keeping a track of project timelines and highlight the risks and impediments, as required

B. MSCI & S&P (N6) API On-boarding (Project Manager/Lead BA)

Worked on analysis required to integrate/onboard the new MSCI & S&P API



Identification of various API end points required to be considered for fetching the desired index header and composition level data



Impact analysis pertaining to various corporate action events and proposed implementation strategy for various index variants

Responsible for end-to-end requirement gathering, vendor data analysis, data modelling, documentation, etc.

Creation of cross referencing (X-ref) logic for golden copy creation

C.

Index/ETF DQ Tool Enhancements

Proposed and implemented various enhancements pertaining to Index/ETF data quality tool (Legion UI)

Creation of wireframes for addition of new functionalities/attributes to be exposed on UI

Coordination with key business stakeholders for getting their approvals on new designs/layouts

2. Legacy Application Decom (Scrum Master cum Project Manager/Lead BA)

Working on automation (idea proposed by me) of comparative vendor analysis for multiple vendors via SQL, UNIX and

Alteryx to ensure the smooth data on boarding from various vendors

Automated (partially) the map-gap analysis for data migration/decom using SQL, Unix and AI/ML tools • Creation of project plan, data migration plan/run-book & other artifacts like BRD, FRD, Project Charter etc. • Keeping a track of project timelines and highlight the risks and impediments, as required

Page 2

Map-gap analysis for comparing the “As Is” and “To Be” state • Mapping the data attributes from legacy application to new application •

Investigation of raw files from various vendors, identification of cross referencing (match and merge) logic

• Proposal of vendor hierarchy on the basis of accuracy and completeness scores (confidence scores) pertaining to each vendor

Identification and implementation of transformation and business rule applicable for each attribute

• Performing functional and UAT testing like creating test data, writing and executing test cases • Writing test cases and performing the UAT • Representing squad in working group, vendor governance meetings, acquiring BU approvals and sign-offs

Ensuring that data model remains intact to ensure that there is no downstream impact

3. EMIR (Derivatives Regulation) Sourcing and Recon Utility

On boarding of EMIR data from Refinitiv • Comparison of vendor data vs client’s internal master data • • Data modelling, artefact creation Setting up frame work for various reports pertaining to EMIR

4. Creation of Multi Source UI

Worked on creation of a multi-source UI which enables ops users to perform a real time comparison of data from multiple

vendors/sources such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv and Exchange Data Feeds

5. MIFID II Recon (Internal reference data vs ESMA/FCA data) - (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)

Created schema for on-boarding a complex data files from ESMA and FCA • Decoding complex business logics from legacy system & replicating same logics on ESMA/FCA data. • Use of data normalization, transformation for creating appropriate data models • Created 10+ customized recon report for transaction reporting team • Recon of 35 (simple) and 27 (complex) attributes through intellimatch. • Analysis and onboarding of 20 complex/huge ESMA/FCA feed files (size ≈ 100GB) containing approx. 20 million rows and 180+ attributes in mongo DB

Recon dashboard creation for displaying age wise exceptions at attribute level. • Participated in Design Council Meetings and various vendor governance meetings • Responsible for writing test cases and performing UAT

6. MIFID II – Direct Sourcing from ESMA/FCA (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)



Eliminating the dependency on external data vendor (Refinitiv) by alternatively sourcing the data directly from ESMA/FCA which is available free of cost.

Data modelling, artefact creation.

Page 3

7. Creation of Bulk Upload Utility (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)

A bulk upload tool was created to upload ESMA/FCA data in client’s internal database • • This eliminated the ops dependency on QAPM to perform multiple backend update on daily basis Implementation of overrides while performing backend updates

8. SFTR Implementation (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)

• RFB implementation on the basis of recommendations from transactions reporting team • Data accuracy and completeness analysis performed for reportable attributes •

Integration of reference data pertaining to SFTR into client’s database

Enhanced instrument as well as entity level (LEI) data coverage by sourcing missing data from ANNA, Refinitiv, GLEIF and Bloomberg, LEI-ISIN mapping file & GLEIF LEI data file.

9. EBR Implementation (Scrum Master Cum Project Manager/Lead BA)

On-boarding of reference data (from Rimes) pertaining to EBR into client’s database • • • Mapped ≈ 48K indices from Equities & 20K from FI universe, enhanced RIC coverage from 75% to 95% Implemented system based control that permits only “Authorized Benchmark” to be used by client for trade booking

Involved in artifact creation, data quality enhancement, GUI creation, writing and executing test cases (UAT)

10. Manual Touch Reduction

Aim was to reduce the manual effort by ops by reducing the exceptions generated via various reports/RFBs

2. Capgemini (Client : UBS) Senior Consultant (Lead Business Analyst cum Project Manager)

June 2017 – Feb 2019

1. Classic Decom (End of Life- Reference Data Migration Project)

Worked as a Project Manager/lead Business Analyst for “End of Life- Migration Project (Fixed Income/ Equities/

Derivatives)” wherein an old legacy application was decommissioned in multiple phases.

Responsible for end to end delivery of the project, right from requirement gathering till go live. • Creation and maintenance of Project Planning documentation and other artifacts • Data Model creation, Identification of new attributes, placeholders and their mapping with respective feed for various asset classes/ financial regulations (EMIR, MiFID, FATCA, Volcker, SFTR) • Requirement analysis and documentation – BRD, FRD, ARS and SDD creation. • Performing functional testing and coordinating for UAT/SIT • DQM/ Exception reports created for new application • Performed map-gap analysis for various (to be migrated) asset classes •

Extensive use of SQL / Unix (beginner) for performing dummy migrations. Exploring ETL/Informatica for identifying mappings/ SQL logics at various levels.

Page 4

2. FinFrag (OTC Derivatives Regulation)/HK Stamp Duty: Regulatory Data Onboarding from SIX Telekurs & HK Exchange

Worked as a Project Manager/lead Business Analyst for onboarding of FinFrag and HK Stamp Duty data • On boarded FinFrag data from SIX Telekurs and HK Stamp duty data from HK exchange files • Creation of critical documents (BRD, FRD) and data modelling for onboarding feed files Project plan

3. European Benchmark Regulation (EBR) Implementation

Worked as a lead BA/PM for onboarding of EBR data (pertaining to indices and benchmarks ) from Rimes and

Refinitiv (external vendors). Created and executed the Project plan

Creation of documents like Project plan , BRD, FRD and did data modelling for onboarding feed files

Identifying and resolving vendor data quality issues

3. IHS Markit AVP (Lead Business Analyst cum Project Manager)

July 2013 – June 2017

1.

Instrument Reference Data Enhancement/Automation Projects:















Lead a team of 2 BAs and 2 developers responsible for delivering key enhancements pertaining to instrument/client reference data offerings of IHS Markit Creation of RFPs (Request for Proposal) to assist sales team while they are pitching for a client Publish daily RAG metrics/ detailed project updates/status to key stakeholders Proposing the logics/rules, triggers and validations to enhance data quality Design, implement, create test data and execute test cases Use of SQL, UNIX, EDM tool in various stages of analysis/testing Exposure to data vendors like Bloomberg, Refinitiv, Clearstream, Euroclear, SEDOL, ANNA & CUSIP web Creation of flowcharts/artifacts related to various enhancements performed by the team



2. Entity Reference Data Enhancement

Analysis of proposed entities offering in comparison to similar offerings by other vendors/IBs. • Build v/s Buy decision analysis on the basis of cost model provided by third party (proposed) vendors • Data modelling, defining the logics, validations, rules pertaining to proposed entity attributes • Also worked on automation of legal entity creation and sector classification from various sources

3. Automation (Internal derivation/sourcing) of Country of Risk (CoR) Values:

Proposed and implemented the CoR derivation logic in IHS Markit • • CoR was derived basis country of Inc, domicile, headquarter location etc. • Acted as a PM cum BA for the end-to-end implementation of this project

This resulted in cost savings worth 2 FTEs

Page 5

4. Fidelity Investments Associate Specialist (Business Analyst)

May 2012 – July 2013

1. Reference Data Enhancement Projects (Analytics & Data Services/Reference Data team)

Worked on enhancements pertaining to their internal reference data applications • Requirement documents creation, testing and other BA related activities • Worked as a BA for on boarding an external vendor (Kingland) for entity hierarchy data

2. Kingland Vendor On boarding (Counter party Data On boarding)

Worked as a BA for end-to-end on boarding of an external vendor (Kingland) for counterparty data (legal name, legal ext,

incorporation, domicile, parent subsidiary relationship/ownership data)

Thomson Reuters (Refinitiv)

July 2011 – Feb 2012

Corporate Actions Analyst

Analysis of various corporate action events from the Reuters news feeds/exchange announcements.  Creation/modification of various corporate action events in various Thomson Reuters products  Handling of the client query related to the database of various corporate action events.

Certifications

Certified Scrum Master (CSM) • CSPO • Claude AI (Anthropic)

Skills

Project Management • Techno Functional Business Analyst • Product/Client Reference Data SME • Data Analysis • SQL • UNIX • Capital Markets • UAT • Leadership • Stakeholder Management • Data Modelling • Strategic Planning • Risk Management • Cross-Functional Collaboration • Agile • Vendor Management • Change Management • Root Cause Analysis

Education

2011 - M.B.A. (Finance) from International Institute of Professional Studies (IIPS), D.A.V.V., Indore
